headline: All pinned contracts verified on Etherscan with three recognized auditors, but most recent audit (ConsenSys Diligence Houston, Dec 2023) is ~17 months stale with no confirmed follow-up covering post-Houston changes

findings.text: rETH (0xae78736cd615f374d3085123a210448e74fc6393) is verified on Etherscan (abiSource: 'etherscan') and is not a proxy contract — no proxy.implementation field returned. RocketStorage (0x1d8f8f00cfa6758d7bE78336684788Fb0ee0Fa46) is likewise verified on Etherscan (abiSource: 'etherscan') and is not a proxy. The legacy RPL token (0xb4efd85c19999d84251304bda99e90b92300bd93) is confirmed verified on Etherscan. RocketVault (0x3bdc69c4e5e13e52a65f5583c23efb9636b469d6) is also confirmed verified. All address_book contracts are non-proxy, independently verified.

A public canonical source repo exists at https://github.com/rocket-pool/rocketpool. Rocket Pool additionally maintains official verification repositories (verify-1.2, verify-v1.1) that compare source code between the official GitHub repo and Etherscan's verified source, demonstrating a deliberate source-to-deployment correspondence practice. No specific deploy-commit SHA was pinned in this run — recorded in unknowns[].

Four audit engagements from recognized firms identified: (1) ConsenSys Diligence, April 2021, covering >6,000 Solidity SLoC across 47 contracts; (2) Sigma Prime, 2021 (PDF at rocketpool.net/files/sigma-prime-audit.pdf, plus fix review); (3) Trail of Bits (PDF confirmed at github.com/trailofbits/publications/blob/master/reviews/RocketPool.pdf); (4) ConsenSys Diligence Atlas v1.2, January 2023, covering minipool delegate, node distributor, deposit credit system; (5) ConsenSys Diligence Houston, December 2023, covering RocketNetworkSnapshot and related DAO/governance contracts. The most recent recognized audit is December 2023, approximately 17 months before the analysis date of 2026-05-07. No confirmed follow-up audit covering post-Houston changes was found.
All auditing firms are broadly recognized: ConsenSys Diligence, Sigma Prime, and Trail of Bits are all named on the recognized list. This is strong auditor recognition.

The most recent recognized audit (ConsenSys Diligence Houston, December 2023) predates the analysis date by approximately 17 months, exceeding the 6-month staleness threshold. No differential or follow-up audit covering post-Houston contract changes was identified in this run. The specific content of any post-Houston changes was not sampled (no GitHub diff fetched in this run) — recorded in unknowns[] as scope limit. Audit staleness alone is a V3/V5 downgrade signal per the grade rubric, pushing from green to orange.

All three pinned address_book contracts (rETH, RocketStorage, RPL legacy) are non-proxy based on surfacer responses returning no proxy.implementation field. No unverified implementation risk applies to these contracts. The broader protocol contract set includes many contracts registered via RocketStorage and swapped via the upgrade system — proxy-like upgradeability is architectural rather than ERC-1967 proxy pattern, but verification status of all registered contracts could not be confirmed in this run — recorded in unknowns[].

steelman.red: If any core fund-custody contracts registered via RocketStorage (e.g., RocketVault, deposit pool) were found to be unverified or if the protocol had no recognized-firm audit at all, red would apply — but all pinned contracts are verified and three recognized firms have audited the system.
steelman.orange: The most recent recognized audit (ConsenSys Diligence Houston, December 2023) is approximately 17 months stale relative to the analysis date, exceeding the 6-month threshold; no confirmed follow-up or differential audit covering post-December 2023 changes was identified, and the broader set of contracts registered through RocketStorage's upgrade mechanism was not fully verified in this run.
steelman.green: All three pinned address_book contracts are verified on Etherscan via a recognized source (abiSource: 'etherscan'), none are proxies, a public canonical GitHub repo exists with official verification scripts, and three broadly recognized firms (ConsenSys Diligence, Sigma Prime, Trail of Bits) have conducted multiple audits including the December 2023 Houston engagement.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because, while all pinned contracts are verified on Etherscan and three recognized auditing firms have covered Rocket Pool across multiple engagements, the most recent recognized audit (ConsenSys Diligence Houston, December 2023) is approximately 17 months before the analysis date of 2026-05-07 — exceeding the 6-month threshold without a confirmed follow-up audit covering post-Houston changes. The orange steel-man is stronger than green because the audit staleness is material and confirmed, not merely a scope gap, and the protocol's architectural upgradeability (RocketStorage-based contract swapping) means new contracts registered since December 2023 may not have been audited.

evidence.shows: rETH (RocketTokenRETH) at 0xae78736cd615f374d3085123a210448e74fc6393 on Ethereum is verified on Etherscan (abiSource: 'etherscan'), is not a proxy (no proxy.implementation field), and exposes standard ERC-20 plus rETH-specific view methods

RocketStorage at 0x1d8f8f00cfa6758d7bE78336684788Fb0ee0Fa46 on Ethereum is verified on Etherscan (abiSource: 'etherscan'), is not a proxy, getDeployedStatus() returns true, getGuardian() returns 0x0cCF14983364A7735d369879603930Afe10df21e
Legacy RPL token at 0xb4efd85c19999d84251304bda99e90b92300bd93 is confirmed verified on Etherscan ('Contract: Verified'); source shows RocketPoolToken (StandardToken, Owned)
RocketVault at 0x3bdc69c4e5e13e52a65f5583c23efb9636b469d6 is confirmed verified on Etherscan ('Contract: Verified'); source includes RocketBase and RocketVaultInterface imports
Canonical public source repository for Rocket Pool smart contracts exists at github.com/rocket-pool/rocketpool

Rocket Pool maintains an official verification repo (verify-1.2) that clones the v1.2 branch and compares source code between the official GitHub repository and Etherscan verified source for each deployed contract address
Trail of Bits audit report for Rocket Pool confirmed present (965 KB PDF) in the trailofbits/publications repository
ConsenSys Diligence audit of Rocket Pool conducted March 8 – April 9, 2021; covered >6,000 Solidity SLoC across 47 logic contracts including RocketTokenRETH and associated system
ConsenSys Diligence Atlas v1.2 audit (January 2023) covering minipool delegate changes, node distributor reentrancy, deposit credit system, and solo migration logic

ConsenSys Diligence Houston audit (December 2023) covering RocketNetworkSnapshot, RocketDAOProtocol, RocketDAOSecurityProposals, and related governance contracts — the most recent recognized audit found

unknowns: V2: No specific deploy-commit SHA was pinned in this run for the current mainnet deployment; source-to-repo correspondence is supported by the verify-1.2 tooling but not independently reproduced in this assessment run

V5: Post-Houston (post-December 2023) contract changes were not sampled via GitHub diff in this run; the presence or absence of material changes to fund-custody contracts since the last audit could not be confirmed

V6: Verification status of all contracts currently registered in RocketStorage (beyond the three pinned address_book entries) could not be confirmed in this run; the architectural upgrade mechanism (RocketStorage-based contract registration) means additional deployed contracts may exist

protocol_metadata.about: Rocket Pool is a decentralised Ethereum liquid staking protocol where users deposit ETH and receive rETH, a liquid staking receipt token that accrues staking rewards over time. Node operators contribute 8–16 ETH and RPL collateral to run validators in pooled 'minipools', with ETH sourced from the deposit pool. The protocol uses a RocketStorage-based architecture where logic contracts are registered by name and can be upgraded by governance, while the vault and rETH token contracts hold user funds and are designed to be non-upgradeable.
